mapper.select: SELECT ss.*, es.subject_name, es.full_score, s.name AS student_name, s.student_number, c.name AS class_name FROM subject_score ss LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = ss.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE ss.exam_id = #{examId} AND ss.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY es.sort ASC
SELECT * FROM subject_score WHERE exam_subject_id = #{examSubjectId} ORDER BY score DESC
